skill.name: record-agent-failure
skill.description: Use when a user challenges an agent outcome, reports a missed prior invariant or repeated correction, or explicitly asks the agent to learn from a failure; do not treat new requirements, new details, first-time preferences, or ordinary refinement as failures.

classifications.requirement_update: The requested feature or contract changed after the outcome.
classifications.requirement_clarification: A previously unavailable detail now clarifies the work.
classifications.preference_update: A preference is stated for the first time.
classifications.real_failure: A prior expectation, controllable mismatch, impact or recurrence risk, and durable prevention lesson are evidenced.
classifications.mixed: Feedback contains both a genuine prior-invariant mismatch and new work.
classifications.uncertain: The available evidence cannot establish the chronology or failure criteria.

policy.trigger_boundary: Only challenged prior outcomes, recurrence reports, or explicit failure qualification/learning requests enter this workflow. Ordinary new requirements and refinements do not.
policy.fallback_only_when: The named tool capability is absent before invocation; never after timeout or ambiguous failure.

mixed_failure_portion.content: Only the prior-invariant mismatch, excluding new work.

policy.user_statement_evidence: An explicit user statement of chronology or a prior invariant is task evidence unless contradicted by available evidence; implementation causes still require evidence.
policy.unknown_cause_boundary: Unknown is valid only when the failure is otherwise established and an evidenced component boundary, prevention, and verification remain available; otherwise classify uncertain.
